summary: VACUUM INTO on an MVCC database incorrectly preserved the source schema_version in the target database header but failed to update the target connection's in-memory schema_version. When the target MVCC database performed its final TRUNCATE checkpoint, the checkpoint wrote the connection's stale schema_version (from the target's own initial state) instead of the copied cookie, causing PRAGMA schema_version to return the wrong value. The fix adds a call to set_mvcc_schema_version_from_header_cookie() after updating the MVCC header, ensuring the connection's schema_version matches the copied header cookie.
